label: Recall.ai
description: Manage meeting bots, recordings, transcript artifacts and linked calendars

operations.name: list_bots
operations.description: List one page of workspace bots; do not use this to poll lifecycle status.

operations.name: get_bot
operations.description: Retrieve a bot on demand. Use provider webhooks for ongoing status changes.

operations.name: create_bot
operations.description: Send a bot now or schedule it to join a meeting; requires meeting recording consent.

operations.name: update_bot
operations.description: Update a scheduled bot before it joins a call.

operations.name: delete_bot
operations.description: Delete a scheduled bot before it joins.

operations.name: leave_call
operations.description: Remove the bot from its current call.

operations.name: pause_recording
operations.description: Pause a bot's ongoing recording.

operations.name: resume_recording
operations.description: Resume a bot's paused recording.

operations.name: send_chat_message
operations.description: Send one meeting chat message. Only Zoom supports recipients other than everyone.

operations.name: list_recordings
operations.description: List recording artifacts, optionally filtered by bot and creation time.

operations.name: get_recording
operations.description: Get recording metadata and artifact download links without downloading media.

operations.name: delete_recording
operations.description: Permanently delete a recording and its artifacts.

operations.name: list_transcripts
operations.description: List transcript artifacts and their status, optionally filtered by recording.

operations.name: get_transcript
operations.description: Retrieve transcript artifact metadata and its download URL, not transcript text.

operations.name: delete_transcript
operations.description: Permanently delete a transcript artifact.

operations.name: list_calendars
operations.description: List calendar connections already linked in the Recall.ai workspace.

operations.name: get_calendar
operations.description: Get a linked calendar's metadata and sync status.

operations.name: delete_calendar
operations.description: Delete an existing calendar connection.

operations.name: list_calendar_events
operations.description: List one linked calendar's events.

operations.name: get_calendar_event
operations.description: Get the meeting details of a calendar event.
